campaign.title: GAR sharp radial-interface physical owner reconciliation

resource_policy.literature_policy: Use no new theorem unless a primary source matches the exact C_X^* coefficient, sharp moving endpoint, real-X star convention, pointwise norm, and physical-limit scope. Existing endpoint theorems must be matched coefficientwise rather than cited by title.

frozen_target.question: After deleting the proved fixed smooth critical sectors and matching the accepted physical endpoint modules coefficientwise, what is the exact remaining sharp radial/interface parent of GAR, and can it be closed or strictly reduced?
frozen_target.reference_formula: G_X=sum_(n<=N_X)^* C_X^*(n)n^(-3/4)e(sqrt(Xn)), N_X=floor(16sqrt X), C_X^*(n)=sum_(hq=n,q odd)chi_4(q)Omega_X^*(n,h), Omega_X^*=sum_j 1_(h<=H_j)Phi(h/(H_j+1))[w_j(2h sqrt(X/n))]^*. Fixed V compact in (c,C), C<16, is target-safe. The physical upper endpoint prefix and aggregate endpoint/R1 module are target-safe only in their accepted physical limits.
quantities: X large real, Y=sqrt X, y=floor(sqrt X), N_X=floor(16Y)
literal radial endpoint star, product half tie, hard j=0 sample, support crossings, and both signs
fixed compact critical transfer for V in C_c^infinity((c,C)), 0<c<C<16
physical upper endpoint prefix H_prof_(infinity,X), not arbitrary finite top height
endpoint boundary operator equals lower prefix plus upper prefix plus recombined R1 arithmetic residue after common routing
open sharp upper/interface remainder after one fixed lower-critical-upper radial partition
candidate flat support edge n=16Y and possible collar-seminorm summation
lower-radial signed aggregate excluded as an independent parent
connector-completed alpha architecture excluded as an additional flat summand

completion_criteria: Reproduce the exact global radial coefficient, external normalization, and one fixed lower-critical-upper partition.
Match the physical upper endpoint prefix and endpoint boundary operator coefficientwise to the sharp radial/interface remainder, including stars and hard samples.
Distinguish an original radial collar or cutoff commutator from an integration-by-parts boundary prefix.
Distinguish the accepted symmetric physical limit from arbitrary finite Mellin or height truncations.
Audit whether fixed compact critical transfer can approach 16 after pricing all cutoff seminorms, or prove a flat-edge collar estimate directly.
Remove each compact, endpoint, residue, transition, and boundary owner exactly once and retain every unmatched interface explicitly.
Prove the complete radial-interface target, a strict target-safe subpackage, or a rigorous no-go with the smallest exact remainder.
State exactly what follows for GAR, the alternative M1 bridge, blockwise M9-M1, M9-M2, endpoint uniformity, and the global exponent.

tasks.target: Independently construct the exact radial owner partition, test whether the proved endpoint modules close the sharp upper/interface parent, and isolate the first unmatched coefficient if not.
excluded_context: all Round-98 and Round-120 nonblind artifacts
required_output: An exact radial owner equation and endpoint/collar distinction.
A proof, strict subpackage, or smallest exact unmatched remainder.
A promote, retain, revise, reject, or no-change recommendation.

tasks.target: Reconcile the exact C_X^* sharp radial-interface remainder with every proved physical endpoint and critical owner, attempt a flat-edge collar bound, and isolate the smallest survivor.
required_output: A coefficientwise one-count table for compact, endpoint, residue, collar, and transition pieces.
A complete bound, target-safe subpackage, or smallest exact remainder.

tasks.target: Hostilely audit every endpoint/collar equality, physical-limit claim, cutoff-seminorm cost, route owner, and downstream implication in the proposed GAR interface reconciliation.
required_output: A pass/fail table for coefficient, endpoint, collar, limit, owner, source, and implication seams.
The maximal safe reconciliation statement or fatal correction.

review_seams.requirement: The lower, compact critical, and sharp upper/interface pieces form one exact physical partition with one endpoint star.
Any endpoint module deleted from the open parent has exactly the same C_X^* coefficient, profile limit, character, and boundary weight.
A sharp radial collar is not replaced by an integration-by-parts prefix unless an exact identity is displayed.
Every approach to n=16Y prices cutoff seminorm growth, lattice length, floors, and support crossings.
Physical symmetric limits and arbitrary finite top heights are never interchanged without a proved uniform theorem.
Endpoint, R1, transition, alpha, lower-radial, and critical owners are removed exactly once and never conjoined across alternative routes.
No GAR, blockwise M9-M1, M9, exponent, or quarter promotion occurs without every required remaining parent.
